title: Meeting Edward Teller before his Los Alamos lecture
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Well, while working at Los Alamos National Lab in 1982, the local newspaper did a front page story on a jet car I had built. Coincidentally, Dr. Edward Teller was giving a speech at Los Alamos that same day.

plain: In 1982, a young man working at Los Alamos National Laboratory in New Mexico says he met the physicist Edward Teller on the day Teller came to give a speech there. That man is Bob Lazar, who later said he worked on alien craft, and he tells Michels he was there himself: the local paper had just run a front-page story on a jet car he had built, and by coincidence Teller was speaking at Los Alamos the same day. If true, it ties Lazar to one of the best-known names in American weapons science.
